GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package closes the feature-activation part of audit finding F05 and the reopened M0.7 gap. The durable unit of rollback is a complete generation, but acknowledged writes after activation need an explicit preservation or recovery policy.

Alternatives.Alternative: Overwrite active files and restore backups on failure. Rejected because crash windows can destroy both active and rollback states.
Keep only an in-memory current revision map. Rejected because fresh-process recovery would reconstruct authority from incomplete state.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: Core and engine updater transport, signing infrastructure, trust-root rotation, and platform fallback are owned by a later system-update change.
Storage layout and retention limits are selected during planning from measured package sizes.

Scenarios.Scenario: Power loss occurs after migrated state is written but before selection; restart keeps the prior generation current.
A candidate starts and crashes repeatedly; it is quarantined and recovery launches without executing it.
A candidate acknowledges a user write and then crashes; automatic rollback proceeds only through its declared lossless policy, otherwise recovery asks for an explicit recovery point.
